questions.question: What should you do for a nosebleed?
questions.correctAnswer: Sit up, lean forward, and pinch the soft part of the nose
questions.explanation: Leaning forward keeps blood from going down the throat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lean forward and pinch gently.

questions.question: How many hours of sleep do kids ages 6 to 12 need?
questions.correctAnswer: 9 to 12 hours
questions.explanation: Sleep is when the brain stores what you learned and the body grows - 9 to 12 hours gives it enough time to do that work.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Kids need 9 to 12 hours of sleep.

questions.question: Which vitamin supports your immune system?
questions.correctAnswer: Vitamin C
questions.explanation: Vitamin C in oranges and peppers supports the immune system, though it does not stop colds by itself.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vitamin C supports your immune system!

questions.question: What is a fire escape plan?
questions.correctAnswer: A plan for how to leave a building safely in a fire
distractors: A plan to fight a fire
A plan to hide from fire
questions.explanation: Every family should know two ways out of each room.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A fire plan shows how to get out fast.

questions.question: What is a vitamin?
questions.correctAnswer: A nutrient the body needs in small amounts to stay healthy
questions.explanation: You only need tiny amounts, but without them things break down: no vitamin C and gums bleed, no vitamin D and bones stay soft.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vitamins are small helpers your body needs.

questions.question: What are amino acids?
questions.correctAnswer: The building blocks of protein
questions.explanation: The body uses amino acids to build and repair tissues.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Amino acids build protein.

questions.question: What is the function of the small intestine?
questions.correctAnswer: To absorb nutrients into the blood
questions.explanation: Most nutrients pass from the small intestine into the blood.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The small intestine absorbs nutrients.

questions.question: What is a healthy friendship?
questions.correctAnswer: A friendship with respect, trust, and kindness
distractors: A friendship where one person controls the other
questions.explanation: In a healthy friendship nobody is the boss: both friends listen, take turns, and feel safe to say no.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Healthy friends are kind and respectful.

questions.question: What is MyPlate?
questions.correctAnswer: A guide showing how to fill your plate with healthy foods
questions.explanation: MyPlate shows half the plate as fruits and vegetables, plus grains and protein.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: MyPlate is a picture of a healthy meal.

questions.question: What is a trusted adult?
questions.correctAnswer: An adult you can go to for help and who will listen
questions.explanation: Trusted adults include parents, teachers, and counselors.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A trusted adult is someone safe to tell.

questions.question: What do the lungs do?
questions.correctAnswer: Take in oxygen and remove carbon dioxide
questions.explanation: Air travels down the windpipe into tiny air sacs, where oxygen passes into the blood and carbon dioxide passes out.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lungs bring in fresh air.

questions.question: What is the immune system?
questions.correctAnswer: The body's defense against germs
questions.explanation: White blood cells patrol the body and attack germs they recognize, and after beating a germ once they remember it for next time.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The immune system is your body's guard.

questions.question: What is the heart?
questions.correctAnswer: The organ that pumps blood through the body
distractors: The organ that helps you breathe
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscle about the size of your fist that squeezes about 100,000 times a day to push blood through miles of vessels.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The heart is the body's pump.

questions.question: What is the digestive system?
questions.correctAnswer: The system that breaks down food and absorbs nutrients
distractors: The system that helps you breathe
questions.explanation: The digestive system includes the mouth, stomach, and intestines.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Digestion turns food into nutrients.

questions.question: What are the main food groups?
questions.correctAnswer: Fruits, vegetables, grains, protein, and dairy
questions.explanation: MyPlate shows five food groups for a balanced diet.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Five food groups make a balanced plate.

questions.question: What is stress?
questions.correctAnswer: The body's response to pressure or change
questions.explanation: Stress can come from school, friends, or big changes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Stress is your body reacting to pressure.

questions.question: Which food group does chicken belong to?
questions.correctAnswer: Protein
questions.explanation: Chicken is mostly protein with little fat, and the body uses that protein to build muscle.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Chicken is protein.

questions.question: What is mental health?
questions.correctAnswer: How you think, feel, and handle life
questions.explanation: Mental health is not just feeling happy - it is being able to handle stress, bounce back from bad days, and ask for help when you need it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mental health is how you feel and cope.

questions.question: What is the skeletal system?
questions.correctAnswer: The bones that support and protect the body
questions.explanation: Bones give shape, support, and protection to organs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Bones hold you up and protect you.

questions.question: What is a goal?
questions.correctAnswer: Something you want to achieve
questions.explanation: A goal turns a wish into a plan: you pick a clear target, break it into steps, and check your progress.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A goal is something you aim for.

questions.question: Why is it important to read food labels?
questions.correctAnswer: To make healthy choices about what you eat
questions.explanation: Labels show sugar, salt, and nutrients so you can choose wisely.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Labels help you choose healthy foods.

questions.question: What is the difference between a vitamin and a mineral?
questions.correctAnswer: Vitamins come from living things; minerals come from soil and rocks
questions.explanation: Vitamins are made by plants and animals, while minerals come from the earth.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vitamins are from life; minerals are from earth.

questions.question: What is herd immunity?
questions.correctAnswer: Protection when enough people are immune so a disease cannot spread easily
questions.explanation: When most people are immune, germs have few people to infect.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Herd immunity protects the whole group.

questions.question: What is the function of the spinal cord?
questions.correctAnswer: To carry messages between the brain and the body
questions.explanation: The spinal cord is the main path for nerve signals.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The spinal cord carries the brain's messages.

questions.question: What is a healthy way to handle stress?
questions.correctAnswer: Exercise, talk to someone, or take deep breaths
questions.explanation: Moving, talking, and slow breathing all lower stress hormones, which is why they work better than yelling or skipping meals.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Move, talk, and breathe to beat stress.

questions.question: Which vitamin does sunlight help your body make?
questions.correctAnswer: Vitamin D
questions.explanation: Sunlight on skin helps the body make vitamin D for strong bones.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sunlight helps make vitamin D.

questions.question: What is fiber?
questions.correctAnswer: A nutrient that helps digestion and keeps you full
questions.explanation: Fiber in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains helps your stomach work well.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Fiber helps your digestion.

questions.question: What is a whole grain?
questions.correctAnswer: A grain that keeps all its parts, like whole wheat
questions.explanation: Whole grains like oats and brown rice have fiber and nutrients.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Whole grains keep all their good parts.

questions.question: How much physical activity should kids get each day?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 60 minutes
questions.explanation: The 60 minutes do not have to happen all at once - walking to school, recess, and playing after dinner all add up.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Kids need 60 minutes of movement a day.

questions.question: What is bullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Repeatedly hurting or teasing someone on purpose
questions.explanation: The key word is repeated: one argument is a disagreement, but the same person hurting you again and again on purpose is bullying.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Bullying is repeated hurt on purpose.

questions.question: What is the difference between a complete protein and an incomplete protein?
questions.correctAnswer: Complete proteins have all essential amino acids; incomplete ones lack some
questions.explanation: Meat and eggs are complete proteins; most plant proteins are incomplete.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Complete protein has all the building blocks.

questions.question: What is a sprain?
questions.correctAnswer: An injury to a ligament around a joint
questions.explanation: Sprains happen when a ligament is stretched or torn, often in the ankle.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A sprain hurts a ligament.

questions.question: What is a germ?
questions.correctAnswer: A tiny organism that can cause sickness
questions.explanation: Germs include bacteria and viruses.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Germs are tiny sickness-causing organisms.

questions.question: What is a calorie?
questions.correctAnswer: A unit of energy in food
questions.explanation: Think of calories as fuel: a granola bar has about 200, and your body burns them to run, think, and stay warm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A calorie is a unit of food energy.

questions.question: What is peer pressure?
questions.correctAnswer: Pressure from friends to do something
questions.explanation: Peer pressure can push you toward good or bad choices.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Peer pressure is friends pushing you to act.

questions.question: What is a vaccine?
questions.correctAnswer: A shot that helps your body fight a disease
distractors: A kind of medicine for a cold
questions.explanation: Vaccines teach the immune system to fight a disease before you get sick.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vaccines train your body to fight germs.

questions.question: What are signs of a concussion?
questions.correctAnswer: Headache, dizziness, confusion, or memory problems
questions.explanation: After a head injury, these signs mean you need medical help.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Headache and confusion after a hit need care.

questions.question: What is a balanced diet?
questions.correctAnswer: Eating foods from all food groups in the right amounts
distractors: Eating as much as you want
questions.explanation: No single food has everything, so a balanced diet mixes the five food groups - each group fills gaps the others leave.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A balanced diet mixes all the food groups.

questions.question: What is the nervous system?
questions.correctAnswer: The system that controls the body with signals
questions.explanation: The brain, spinal cord, and nerves send messages through the body.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Nerves carry the body's messages.

questions.question: What is the emergency number in the United States?
questions.explanation: 911 connects you to police, fire, or an ambulance, and the dispatcher will ask where you are and what happened - stay on the line.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 911 is the emergency number.

questions.question: What is the function of the kidneys?
questions.correctAnswer: To filter waste from the blood
questions.explanation: Kidneys remove waste and extra water, making urine.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Kidneys clean the blood.

questions.question: What does nicotine do to the body?
questions.correctAnswer: It is addictive and harms the lungs and heart
questions.explanation: Nicotine in cigarettes and vapes is addictive and damages health.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Nicotine is addictive and harmful.

questions.question: What is health?
questions.correctAnswer: A state of physical, mental, and social well-being
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization defines health as complete physical, mental, and social well-being - not just the absence of sickness.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Health is body, mind, and friendships together.

questions.question: What is the difference between a concussion and a bruise?
questions.correctAnswer: A concussion is a brain injury; a bruise is bleeding under the skin
distractors: A bruise is a brain injury
questions.explanation: A concussion happens when the brain is shaken inside the skull.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A concussion hurts the brain; a bruise hurts the skin.

questions.question: What does iron do for your body?
questions.correctAnswer: Helps blood carry oxygen
questions.explanation: Iron helps red blood cells carry oxygen around the body.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Iron helps your blood carry oxygen.

questions.question: Which vitamin helps your eyes see well?
questions.correctAnswer: Vitamin A
questions.explanation: Vitamin A, found in carrots and sweet potatoes, supports vision.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Vitamin A helps your eyes.

questions.question: What is the circulatory system?
questions.correctAnswer: The system that moves blood around the body
distractors: The system that helps you breathe
questions.explanation: The heart, blood, and vessels make up the circulatory system.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Circulation moves blood everywhere.

questions.question: What does calcium do for your body?
questions.correctAnswer: Builds strong bones and teeth
questions.explanation: Calcium from milk and leafy greens keeps bones strong.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Calcium builds strong bones.

questions.question: What are signs of dehydration?
questions.correctAnswer: Thirst, dry mouth, and dark urine
questions.explanation: By the time you feel thirsty you are already a little dehydrated, and dark yellow urine is another early warning sign.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Thirst and dark urine mean drink water.

questions.question: How long should you wash your hands with soap?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 20 seconds
questions.explanation: Washing for 20 seconds removes most germs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sing Happy Birthday twice while you wash.

questions.question: What is wellness?
questions.correctAnswer: Actively making choices for a healthy life
questions.explanation: Wellness is active, not luck: it means choosing sleep, movement, and good food on purpose instead of waiting until you feel sick.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Wellness is living healthy on purpose.

questions.question: Which food group does milk belong to?
questions.correctAnswer: Dairy
questions.explanation: Dairy foods come from milk - cheese and yogurt count too, and they are the main source of calcium in most kids' diets.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Milk is dairy.

questions.question: What does the ingredients list on a food label show?
questions.correctAnswer: The ingredients in the food, from most to least
questions.explanation: Ingredients are listed in order by weight, so the first ingredient is the one there is most of.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: First ingredient means most of it!

questions.question: What is the difference between a need and a want?
questions.correctAnswer: A need is required to live; a want is nice to have
distractors: A need is nice to have
questions.explanation: Food and water are needs; toys are wants.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Needs keep you alive; wants are extras.

questions.question: What is the difference between a virus and a bacterium?
questions.correctAnswer: Bacteria are living cells; viruses need a host cell to reproduce
questions.explanation: Bacteria are single cells that eat and divide by themselves; a virus is just a package of instructions that can only copy itself inside a living cell.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Bacteria live alone; viruses need a host.

questions.question: Why should you wear a helmet when riding a bike?
questions.correctAnswer: To protect your head from injury
questions.explanation: A helmet can prevent serious head injuries in a fall.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A helmet protects your brain.

questions.question: What is consent?
questions.correctAnswer: Permission given freely for something to happen
questions.explanation: Consent means saying yes freely, and it can be taken back.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Consent is a free and clear yes.

questions.question: When should you wash your hands?
questions.correctAnswer: Before eating and after using the bathroom
questions.explanation: Handwashing stops germs from spreading.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Wash before eating and after the bathroom.

questions.question: What is the respiratory system?
questions.correctAnswer: The system that brings in oxygen
questions.explanation: The respiratory system includes the nose, trachea, and lungs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Breathing is the respiratory system.

questions.question: What is dehydration?
questions.correctAnswer: Not having enough water in the body
questions.explanation: Dehydration can cause headaches, tiredness, and dizziness.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Dehydration means you need water.

questions.question: Why should you finish all of your antibiotics?
questions.correctAnswer: To kill all the bacteria and prevent resistance
questions.explanation: Stopping early can let strong bacteria survive and become resistant.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Finish antibiotics so germs cannot come back stronger.

questions.question: What is empathy?
questions.correctAnswer: Understanding how someone else feels
questions.explanation: Empathy is noticing how someone feels from their face and words, and imagining how you would feel in their place.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Empathy is feeling with someone else.

questions.question: Which food group does bread belong to?
questions.correctAnswer: Grains
questions.explanation: Bread is made from grains like wheat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Bread comes from grains.

questions.question: What is depression?
questions.correctAnswer: A long period of sadness and loss of interest
questions.explanation: Depression lasts weeks or more and needs support and care.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Depression is lasting sadness that needs help.

questions.question: What is the function of the large intestine?
questions.correctAnswer: To absorb water and form waste
questions.explanation: After the small intestine takes the nutrients, the large intestine soaks up the leftover water - that is what turns liquid waste into solid stool.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The large intestine reclaims water.

questions.question: Which food group do carrots belong to?
questions.correctAnswer: Vegetables
questions.explanation: Carrots grow underground as roots, and their orange color comes from beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Carrots are vegetables.

questions.question: How much of your plate should be fruits and vegetables?
questions.correctAnswer: About half
questions.explanation: Fruits and vegetables are low in calories but high in fiber and vitamins, so half a plate of them fills you up without overloading on energy.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Half your plate should be fruits and veggies.

questions.question: What is the function of the liver?
questions.correctAnswer: To clean the blood and help digest fats
questions.explanation: The liver filters blood and makes bile to digest fats.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The liver cleans blood and helps digestion.

questions.question: How many glasses of water should kids drink each day?
questions.correctAnswer: About 6 to 8 glasses
questions.explanation: Kids need about 6 to 8 cups of water a day, more when active.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: About 6 to 8 glasses a day keeps you hydrated.

questions.question: What is the muscular system?
questions.correctAnswer: The muscles that move the body
questions.explanation: Muscles work with bones to create movement.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Muscles make you move.

questions.question: What should you do if you see bullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Telling an adult helps stop bullying and keeps people safe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tell a trusted adult.

questions.question: What is a habit?
questions.correctAnswer: Something you do regularly
questions.explanation: Habits like brushing teeth become automatic over time.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A habit is something you do often.

questions.question: What is a nutrient?
questions.correctAnswer: A substance in food that the body needs
questions.explanation: Nutrients include vitamins, minerals, protein, and carbohydrates.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Nutrients are the useful parts of food.

questions.question: What should you do first for a small cut?
questions.correctAnswer: Wash it with soap and water and cover it
questions.explanation: Soap and water wash out dirt and germs that cause infection, and the bandage keeps new germs out while the skin heals.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Clean it, then cover it.

questions.question: What is lactose intolerance?
questions.correctAnswer: Trouble digesting milk sugar
questions.explanation: People with lactose intolerance lack enough lactase to digest milk.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lactose intolerance means milk is hard to digest.

questions.question: Why should you limit sugary drinks?
questions.correctAnswer: They add sugar and calories without nutrients
questions.explanation: Soda and sweet drinks can lead to cavities and weight gain.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sugary drinks add sugar with no nutrition.

questions.question: What are antibiotics used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To kill bacteria
questions.explanation: Antibiotics attack parts only bacteria have, like cell walls - viruses do not have those parts, so the medicine has nothing to attack.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Antibiotics fight bacteria, not viruses.

questions.question: What does the stomach do?
questions.correctAnswer: Breaks down food
questions.explanation: The stomach mixes food with acids to digest it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The stomach starts digesting your food.

questions.question: What does the brain do?
questions.correctAnswer: Controls the body and helps you think
questions.explanation: The brain controls movement, thoughts, and feelings.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The brain is the body's control center.

questions.question: What is a drug?
questions.correctAnswer: A substance that changes how the body or mind works
questions.explanation: Drugs include medicine, alcohol, nicotine, and illegal substances.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A drug changes how your body or mind works.

questions.question: What should you do if your clothes catch fire?
questions.correctAnswer: Stop, drop, and roll
questions.explanation: Stop, drop, and roll smothers the flames.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Stop, drop, and roll puts out the fire.

questions.question: What is a food allergy?
questions.correctAnswer: An immune reaction to a food
questions.explanation: Food allergies can cause hives, swelling, or trouble breathing.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A food allergy is an immune reaction.

questions.question: Why should you wear sunscreen?
questions.correctAnswer: To protect your skin from harmful UV rays
questions.explanation: UV rays are invisible light that damages skin cells; sunscreen absorbs or reflects them, and it wears off, so you must reapply.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sunscreen blocks harmful sun rays.

questions.question: What is a serving size?
questions.correctAnswer: The amount of food listed on a label
questions.explanation: Nutrition facts are based on one serving, not the whole package.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A serving is the amount the label counts.

questions.question: Why should you brush your teeth twice a day?
questions.correctAnswer: To remove plaque and prevent cavities
distractors: To make breath smell good only
questions.explanation: Brushing removes food and bacteria that cause cavities.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Brushing stops cavities before they start.

questions.question: What does protein do for your body?
questions.correctAnswer: Builds and repairs muscles and tissues
questions.explanation: Protein is made of amino acids, and the body links them together to build muscle, skin, and the cells that fight infection.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Protein builds and repairs your body.

questions.question: Why is water important for your body?
questions.correctAnswer: It keeps you hydrated and helps your body work
questions.explanation: Water carries nutrients, removes waste, and controls temperature.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Water keeps your body running.

questions.question: What is the Heimlich maneuver used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To help someone who is choking
distractors: To help someone who is bleeding
To help someone with a broken bone
questions.explanation: Abdominal thrusts can push out food blocking the airway.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: The Heimlich helps a choking person.

questions.question: What is a fracture?
questions.correctAnswer: A broken bone
questions.explanation: A fracture can be a tiny crack or a bone broken in two - either way the bone needs rest, often in a cast, to grow back together.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: A fracture is a broken bone.

questions.question: Which food group do apples belong to?
questions.correctAnswer: Fruits
questions.explanation: Apples are fruits because they grow from a flower and hold seeds inside - and one medium apple has about 4 grams of fiber.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Apples are fruits.

questions.question: What is physical activity?
questions.correctAnswer: Any movement that uses your muscles
questions.explanation: Walking, dancing, and playing all count as physical activity.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Moving your body is physical activity.

questions.question: What is the glycemic index?
questions.correctAnswer: A measure of how fast a food raises blood sugar
distractors: A measure of fat in food
questions.explanation: The glycemic index ranks foods 0 to 100 by how fast they turn into blood sugar: white bread is near 70, while lentils are near 30.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Glycemic index tracks blood sugar speed.

questions.question: What is added sugar?
questions.correctAnswer: Sugar added to food during processing
questions.explanation: Added sugar in soda and candy gives energy but few nutrients.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Added sugar is sugar put in during making.

questions.question: What do carbohydrates give your body?
questions.correctAnswer: Energy
questions.explanation: Carbs break down into glucose, the fuel the brain and muscles use first - that is why athletes eat pasta before a big game.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Carbs are fuel for your body.

questions.question: What is a neuron?
questions.correctAnswer: A nerve cell that carries signals
questions.explanation: Neurons send electrical signals through the nervous system.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Neurons are the nervous system's messengers.

questions.question: What is the RICE method for injuries?
questions.correctAnswer: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation
questions.explanation: RICE helps treat sprains and strains.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: RICE is Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.

questions.question: What is the difference between saturated and unsaturated fat?
questions.correctAnswer: Saturated fat is usually solid and less healthy; unsaturated fat is usually liquid and healthier
questions.explanation: Olive oil is unsaturated, while butter is saturated.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Liquid fats are usually the healthier kind.

questions.question: Why is sleep important?
questions.correctAnswer: It helps your body grow and your brain learn
questions.explanation: Sleep helps memory, growth, and mood.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Sleep helps you grow and learn.

questions.question: What is CPR?
questions.correctAnswer: An emergency method to keep blood and oxygen moving when the heart stops
questions.explanation: CPR uses chest compressions to help a person whose heart has stopped.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: CPR keeps blood moving in an emergency.

questions.question: What is anxiety?
questions.correctAnswer: Feeling worried or nervous
questions.explanation: A little anxiety before a test is normal and can even help you focus, but worry that lasts weeks and stops you doing things needs support.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Anxiety is worry and nervousness.
